run_curate_scannet: run the python module to curate ScanNet++ data by passing a config file path
extract_rgb_frames: extract RGB frames from an iPhone video using ffmpeg at a specified resolution
extract_mask_frames: extract grayscale mask frames from an iPhone video using ffmpeg at a specified resolution
extract_depth_frames: decompress and extract depth frames from a compressed depth file using zlib or lz4
review_main_pipeline: review the main pipeline that processes scenes, extracts RGB masks and depth, and writes JSONL output
